prompt:
Score each onboarding change. Sub-scores:
- impact 0-3: how many users the targeted step loses and how much this could recover
- evidence 0-3: whether the funnel and the support mail both point at this problem
- confidence 0-2: how likely this kind of change works, judged from the lessons below
- cost 0-2: 2 = config only, 0 = needs new screens and a release
Also give predicted_lift: expected relative change in the target step's conversion, e.g. 0.05.

Lessons from earlier weeks:
(none yet)

Measured so far, by kind of change (relative change on the target step):
(not available)

Funnel:
- choose_path: 76.2%, median 8s / mean 514s
- sign_in: 78.9%, median 3s / mean 567s
- adoption: 60.9%, median 89s / mean 1017s
- home: 87.7%, median 201s / mean 2336s
- finish: 64.8%, median 395s / mean 5815s
- finishing onboarding overall: 20.8%

Return JSON {"scores": [{"index": i, "impact": n, "evidence": n, "confidence": n, "cost": n,
"predicted_lift": x, "note": short}]}

Changes:
0: [finish, new_screen] Interactive Desktop Pet Control Overview Screen: Add a dedicated interactive quick-controls guide screen after home intro showing how to move, hide, and summon the desktop pet. (why: Multiple support emails mention post-onboarding confusion regarding how to control or hide the pet, and finish step drops to 64.8%.)
1: [sign_in, reorder] Post-Waiting Sign-In Reorder: Move the sign_in screen to take place after waiting pet generation and before the final home introduction. (why: Sign in currently has a high mean time of 567s early in the journey; moving it after pet generation lets heavy background rendering finish while the user signs in.)
2: [adoption, hint] Custom Photo Upload Quality Guidance Hint: Add clear image resolution and lighting tips to the photo upload screen during custom pet creation. (why: 3 support emails reported custom pet generation failing or producing bad visual results, contributing to adoption step drop-off.)
3: [home, wait_info] Desktop Placement Troubleshooting Wait Info: Display system tray permission guidance and rendering status on the waiting screen while the pet is prepared. (why: 3 support emails reported pets failing to show on the desktop or app failing to launch, while home waiting step has high latency.)
4: [finish, notification] Desktop Tray Quick-Access Notification Banner: Include a system tray shortcut reminder on the final welcome screen explaining how to summon or minimize the pet. (why: 3 support emails noted confusion around hiding or revealing the pet after setup, contributing to finish drop-off.)
5: [choose_path, layout] Spotlight View Path Selection Layout: Switch the path selection layout to spotlight mode, focusing clearly on one creation path at a time. (why: choose_path has a median duration of 8s but a mean duration of 514s, showing that undecided users stall on option choice.)
